tasks.source: JetBlue's whole network from 04:00 Eastern on real storm days at JFK and Boston from December 2022 to July 2026: the flights, tails and delays from BTS on-time data, aircraft from Form 41 B-43 and the FAA registry, the FAA Command Center's ground stops and ground delay programs as issued; pilots under FAR 117 and flight attendants under 14 CFR 121.467 on trips generated from the published schedule, with reserves at a sourced industry band; passengers generated per flight from BTS T-100 loads and the DB1B (to 2025 Q2) or DB1C (from 2025-07) itinerary survey of each date's own period, connecting at JFK, BOS, FLL, MCO and SJU, domestic itineraries only
tasks.selection: the pack's eval dates: per hub 8 summer and 4 winter storm dates, each from its own storm event, where the FAA's programs controlled or held at least 5 JetBlue flights and the crew model passed its filter (at most 1% of JetBlue's flown flights without a legal crew, crews adding at most 2% to the calm day); they are b6-v2's 24 eval dates, drawn with seed 0 and fixed before the v2 board

grading.reference: the cheapest plan of aircraft and crews under the passenger cost P among v2's best plan, B0, the passenger-aware aircraft plans played through the standard crew desk and a repair of the best of them, replayed exactly with a legal crew on every flight; published with a capacity-aware lower bound where one was found
grading.reward: 0.2 + 0.8 exp(-g/0.5), g = max(0, P - best) / max(B0 - best, 0.1 best), B0 being standard crew-desk practice with the aircraft doing nothing; P in passenger-minutes: each passenger's arrival delay at the final destination after JetBlue-only rebooking (up to five days, then a refund), 66 per cancelled passenger (more when decided under 2 hours ahead), a lodging night per night away, each refunded fare, and v2's aircraft and crew costs; reward_L is the same against the bound
grading.excused: nothing: a run is scored only if its audit passes (news, turns, causality, roles, crew legality, the bound, the desks' presence); a day that comes in under the best plan, which is not a proven optimum, scores 1.0 and is flagged below_best (12 of 48 runs: both modes on 5 dates, three desks alone on 2), with reward_L beside it

baselines.name: B0: standard crew-desk practice, the aircraft doing nothing
doing nothing: the planned crews by the trip rule, no desk
v2's best plan, blind to passengers, played with them
the airline: JetBlue's own decisions, replayed with the generated crews and passengers
